<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin;

use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\TestDox;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\BinaryFileResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support\InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

/**
 * Capsule T4 — platform-admin export of a single event's registration list.
 *
 * The rows carry attendee personal data, so the endpoint must be gated by the
 * same global capability that already governs platform-wide event visibility
 * (events.view.global) rather than by generic admin-area membership.
 */
class AdminEventRegistrationExportTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    private const EXPORT_ROUTE = 'admin.events.registrations.export';

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 / AC4 / AC5 — CSV download scoped to the requested event
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-01 [P0] Given a platform admin when they export an event then only that event\'s registrations are streamed as a CSV download')]
    public function platform_admin_exports_only_the_requested_events_registrations(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $otherWorkspace = $this->createWorkspace();

        $event = Event::factory()->for($workspace)->create(['title' => 'Delivery Complaint Event']);
        $otherEvent = Event::factory()->for($otherWorkspace)->create(['title' => 'Unrelated Event']);

        $this->registerAttendee($event, 'first.attendee@example.test');
        $this->registerAttendee($event, 'second.attendee@example.test');
        $this->registerAttendee($otherEvent, 'other.event.attendee@example.test');

        $admin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->exportUrl($event));

        $response->assertOk();

        // AC5 — delivered as a CSV download naming the event it belongs to.
        $this->assertStringContainsString('text/csv', (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Type'));
        $disposition = (string) $response->headers->get('Content-Disposition');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('attachment', $disposition);
        $this->assertStringContainsString($event->uuid, $disposition);

        // AC4 — the requested event's registrations, and nothing from another event.
        $body = $this->bodyOf($response);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('first.attendee@example.test', $body);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('second.attendee@example.test', $body);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('other.event.attendee@example.test', $body);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — admin-area access alone does not unlock attendee personal data
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-02 [P0] Given an admin-area user without global event visibility when they request the export then they are refused and receive no registration data')]
    public function admin_area_user_without_global_event_visibility_is_refused(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = Event::factory()->for($workspace)->create(['title' => 'Delivery Complaint Event']);
        $this->registerAttendee($event, 'protected.attendee@example.test');

        // Reaches the admin area (system-admin flagged role) but was never
        // granted the global event-visibility capability.
        $role = Role::query()->create([
            'name' => 'Support Desk Without Event Visibility',
            'key' => 't4-support-desk-no-event-visibility',
            'description' => 'Test-only system role that reaches the admin area but cannot view events platform-wide.',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => true,
        ]);

        $supportUser = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $workspace->id,
        ]);
        $workspace->users()->attach($supportUser, ['role' => $role->key]);
        $supportUser = $supportUser->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        // Precondition: this actor genuinely reaches the platform-admin area.
        $this->actingAs($supportUser)->get(route('admin.dashboard'))->assertOk();

        $response = $this->actingAs($supportUser)->get($this->exportUrl($event));

        $response->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('protected.attendee@example.test', $this->bodyOf($response));
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC2 / AC6 — config gating agrees with the endpoint, neighbours untouched
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('T4-EXPORT-03 [P0] Given the route-permission config when the export route is added then it requires global event visibility and pre-existing admin event entries are unchanged')]
    public function export_route_is_capability_gated_without_widening_existing_admin_routes(): void
    {
        /** @var array<string, string|null> $permissions */
        $permissions = config('route_permissions.routes');

        $this->assertSame(
            'events.view.global',
            $permissions[self::EXPORT_ROUTE] ?? null,
            'The export route must be gated by the global event-visibility capability it enforces.',
        );

        // AC6 — the neighbouring admin event entries keep their original gates.
        $this->assertSame('events.view.global', $permissions['admin.events.index'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('events.view.global', $permissions['admin.events.show'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('events.update.global', $permissions['admin.events.edit'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('system_admin_access', $permissions['admin.dashboard'] ?? null);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private function exportUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        $this->assertTrue(
            Route::has(self::EXPORT_ROUTE),
            'Named route ['.self::EXPORT_ROUTE.'] does not exist.',
        );

        return route(self::EXPORT_ROUTE, $event->uuid);
    }

    private function registerAttendee(Event $event, string $email): Registration
    {
        return Registration::unguarded(fn (): Registration => Registration::query()->create([
            'team_id' => $event->team_id,
            'event_id' => $event->id,
            'email' => $email,
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
            'source' => 'direct',
            'full_name' => 'Attendee '.substr(md5($email), 0, 6),
            'consent_accepted_at' => now(),
        ]));
    }

    private function bodyOf(TestResponse $response): string
    {
        $base = $response->baseResponse;

        if ($base instanceof StreamedResponse || $base instanceof BinaryFileResponse) {
            return $response->streamedContent();
        }

        return (string) $base->getContent();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support;

use App\Enums\TeamStatus;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\RolePermission;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;

trait InteractsWithSuperAdmin
{
    /**
     * Ensure roles + permissions are seeded before each test.
     *
     * Tests using this trait may extend TestCase directly (not FeatureTestCase)
     * and therefore do not call seedPermissionsOnce() in their own setUp.
     * The count guard prevents double-seeding when a test also inherits from
     * FeatureTestCase (which already calls the same seeder).
     *
     * Added by Story 1-11C for UserAdministrationTest.
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        if (RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Create the platform's is_system_team team for tests that exercise the
     * grantSystemAdmin / revokeSystemAdmin service paths.
     *
     * The production system team is seeded by SuperadminSeeder; in tests with
     * RefreshDatabase it must be created explicitly before calling the grant
     * service method.
     */
    protected function createSystemTeam(): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);

        /** @var Team $team */
        $team = Team::factory()->create([
            'user_id'         => $owner->id,
            'is_system_team'  => true,
            'personal_team'   => false,
        ]);

        return $team;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $teamAttributes
     */
    protected function createWorkspace(array $teamAttributes = []): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        /** @var Team $team */
        $team = Team::factory()
            ->nonPersonal()
            ->create(array_merge(['user_id' => $owner->id], $teamAttributes));

        $team->users()->attach($owner, ['role' => UserRole::ownerDefault()->value]);
        $owner->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        /** @var Team $freshTeam */
        $freshTeam = $team->fresh(['owner', 'users']);

        return $freshTeam;
    }

    protected function createPlatformSuperAdmin(?Team $team = null): User
    {
        $workspace = $team ?? $this->createWorkspace();
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $workspace->id,
        ]);

        $workspace->users()->attach($user, ['role' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value]);

        /** @var User $freshUser */
        $freshUser = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        return $freshUser;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    protected function createWorkspaceMember(Team $team, UserRole $role, array $attributes = []): User
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = User::factory()->create(array_merge([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $team->id,
        ], $attributes));

        $team->users()->attach($user, ['role' => $role->value]);

        /** @var User $freshUser */
        $freshUser = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        return $freshUser;
    }

    protected function suspendWorkspace(Team $team): Team
    {
        $team->forceFill(['status' => TeamStatus::SUSPENDED])->save();

        /** @var Team $freshTeam */
        $freshTeam = $team->fresh();

        return $freshTeam;
    }
}

class EventExportService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntitlementChecker $entitlements,
        private readonly AiTranscriptService $transcripts,
        private readonly AiPostEventOverviewService $overviews,
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authorization,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{filename: string, rows: list<list<string>>}
     */
    public function build(Event $event, User $actor, EventExportType $type): array
    {
        $this->authorization->authorizeView($event, $actor);

        $eventBoundAiExport = $type === EventExportType::AI_OUTPUTS
            && $this->transcripts->authorizedForEvent($event);
        if (! $eventBoundAiExport
            && ! $this->entitlements->hasFreshEntitlementForTeam(
                $actor,
                $event->team_id,
                PlanEntitlement::EXPORTS,
            )) {
            throw PlanGateFailed::for($event, PlanEntitlement::EXPORTS->value);
        }

        return [
            'filename' => sprintf('%s-%s.csv', $this->safeFilenameStem($event), $type->value),
            'rows' => match ($type) {
                EventExportType::REGISTRANTS => $this->registrantRows($event, attendeesOnly: false),
                EventExportType::ATTENDEES => $this->registrantRows($event, attendeesOnly: true),
                EventExportType::QUESTIONS => $this->questionRows($event),
                EventExportType::POLLS => $this->pollRows($event),
                EventExportType::AI_OUTPUTS => $this->aiOutputRows($event, $actor),
            },
        ];
    }

    public function response(Event $event, User $actor, EventExportType $type): StreamedResponse
    {
        $export = $this->build($event, $actor, $type);

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($export): void {
            $handle = fopen('php://output', 'wb');
            if ($handle === false) {
                return;
            }

            foreach ($export['rows'] as $row) {
                fputcsv($handle, $row, escape: '\\');
            }

            fclose($handle);
        }, $export['filename'], [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function registrantRows(Event $event, bool $attendeesOnly): array
    {
        $query = Registration::query()
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id');

        if ($attendeesOnly) {
            $query->whereNotNull('attended_at');
        }

        $rows = [$this->headers($attendeesOnly ? EventExportType::ATTENDEES : EventExportType::REGISTRANTS)];

        /** @var Collection<int, Registration> $registrations */
        $registrations = $query->get();
        foreach ($registrations as $index => $registration) {
            $rows[] = [
                (string) ($index + 1),
                (string) $registration->full_name,
                (string) ($registration->company ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->title ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->country ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->industry ?? ''),
                (string) $registration->source,
                $registration->attended_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',
                $registration->created_at->toIso8601String(),
            ];
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function questionRows(Event $event): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers(EventExportType::QUESTIONS)];

        EngagementQuestion::query()
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get()
            ->each(function (EngagementQuestion $question, int $index) use (&$rows): void {
                $rows[] = [
                    (string) ($index + 1),
                    $question->state->value,
                    $question->is_pinned ? 'yes' : 'no',
                    (string) $question->body,
                    $question->created_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',
                ];
            });

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function pollRows(Event $event): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers(EventExportType::POLLS)];

        EngagementPoll::query()
            ->with(['options' => fn ($query) => $query->withCount('votes')])
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get()
            ->each(function (EngagementPoll $poll) use (&$rows): void {
                foreach ($poll->options as $option) {
                    $rows[] = [
                        (string) $poll->id,
                        $poll->state->value,
                        (string) $poll->question,
                        (string) $option->ordinal,
                        (string) $option->label,
                        (string) ($option->votes_count ?? 0),
                    ];
                }
            });

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function aiOutputRows(Event $event, User $actor): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers(EventExportType::AI_OUTPUTS)];

        if ($this->transcripts->authorizedForEvent($event)) {
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow(
                'transcript',
                $this->transcripts->forEvent($event),
                'transcript_text',
            );
        }

        if ($this->hasEntitlement($actor, $event, PlanEntitlement::AI_INSIGHTS)) {
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow('engagement_summary', AiEventEngagementSummary::query()->where('event_id', $event->id)->first(), 'summary');
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow('interest_signals', AiEventInterestSignal::query()->where('event_id', $event->id)->first(), 'signals');
        }

        if ($this->overviews->authorizedForEvent($event)) {
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow(
                'post_event_overview',
                AiEventPostEventOverview::query()
                    ->where('team_id', $event->team_id)
                    ->where('event_id', $event->id)
                    ->first(),
                'overview',
            );
        }

        return array_values(array_filter($rows, fn (array $row): bool => $row !== []));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function aiRow(string $outputType, ?Model $record, string $payloadField): array
    {
        if ($record === null) {
            return [];
        }

        $status = $record->getAttribute('status');
        $readyAt = $record->getAttribute('ready_at');
        $payload = $record->getAttribute($payloadField);

        return [
            $outputType,
            is_object($status) && property_exists($status, 'value') ? (string) $status->value : (string) $status,
            (string) ($record->getAttribute('prompt_version') ?? ''),
            (string) ($record->getAttribute('model_id') ?? ''),
            $readyAt instanceof Carbon ? $readyAt->toIso8601String() : '',
            is_array($payload) ? json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?: '' : (string) ($payload ?? ''),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function headers(EventExportType $type): array
    {
        $headers = __('events.exports.headers.'.$type->value);

        return is_array($headers) ? array_values(array_map('strval', $headers)) : [];
    }

    private function safeFilenameStem(Event $event): string
    {
        $slug = str((string) $event->title)->slug('-')->toString();

        return $slug !== '' ? $slug : 'event-'.$event->id;
    }

    private function hasEntitlement(User $actor, Event $event, PlanEntitlement $entitlement): bool
    {
        return $this->entitlements->hasFreshEntitlementForTeam($actor, $event->team_id, $entitlement);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\Authz\Http;

use InvalidArgumentException;

class RouteRequirementResolver
{
    /** @var array<string, string> Map of special permission names to user method names */
    private array $specialPermissions;

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $specialPermissions Map of special permission name => user method name
     */
    public function __construct(array $specialPermissions = [])
    {
        $this->specialPermissions = $specialPermissions;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the requirement for a given route name.
     *
     * Reads from config('route_permissions.routes') and parses the permission
     * string into a structured RouteRequirement.
     *
     * @return RouteRequirement|null Null if route not found in config
     */
    public function resolve(string $routeName): ?RouteRequirement
    {
        $routes = config('route_permissions.routes', []);

        if (!array_key_exists($routeName, $routes)) {
            return null; // Missing mapping is handled as a fail-closed error by the middleware.
        }

        $permissionString = $routes[$routeName];

        if ($permissionString === null) {
            return new RouteRequirement(RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE);
        }

        return $this->parse($permissionString);
    }

    /**
     * Parse a permission string into a RouteRequirement.
     *
     * Supports:
     *   - 'capability.string.scope' → TYPE_SINGLE
     *   - 'cap1 | cap2' → TYPE_ANY_OF
     *   - 'cap1 & cap2' → TYPE_ALL_OF (each part may contain | for OR)
     *   - 'system_admin_access' → TYPE_SPECIAL (if in specialPermissions map)
     */
    public function parse(string $permissionString): RouteRequirement
    {
        $permissionString = trim($permissionString);

        if ($permissionString === '__public__') {
            return new RouteRequirement(RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC);
        }

        // Check if it's a special permission
        if (isset($this->specialPermissions[$permissionString])) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL,
                specialMethod: $this->specialPermissions[$permissionString],
            );
        }

        // Split by '&' for AND clauses
        $andClauses = array_map('trim', explode('&', $permissionString));
        $andClauses = array_filter($andClauses, fn(string $c) => $c !== '');

        if (count($andClauses) === 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.');
        }

        if (count($andClauses) === 1) {
            // Single clause — might contain | for OR
            return $this->parseClause($andClauses[0]);
        }

        // Multiple AND clauses — each is a sub-requirement
        $subRequirements = array_map(fn(string $clause) => $this->parseClause($clause), $andClauses);

        return new RouteRequirement(
            type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF,
            clauses: $subRequirements,
        );
    }

    private function parseClause(string $clause): RouteRequirement
    {
        $clause = trim($clause);

        // Check if this clause is a special permission
        if (isset($this->specialPermissions[$clause])) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL,
                specialMethod: $this->specialPermissions[$clause],
            );
        }

        // Check for OR (|)
        $orParts = array_map('trim', explode('|', $clause));
        $orParts = array_filter($orParts, fn(string $p) => $p !== '');

        if (count($orParts) === 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.');
        }

        if (count($orParts) === 1) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE,
                capabilities: [$orParts[0]],
            );
        }

        return new RouteRequirement(
            type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF,
            capabilities: $orParts,
        );
    }
}

use InvalidArgumentException;

class RouteRequirementResolver
{
    /** @var array<string, string> Map of special permission names to user method names */
    private array $specialPermissions;

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $specialPermissions Map of special permission name => user method name
     */
    public function __construct(array $specialPermissions = [])
    {
        $this->specialPermissions = $specialPermissions;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the requirement for a given route name.
     *
     * Reads from config('route_permissions.routes') and parses the permission
     * string into a structured RouteRequirement.
     *
     * @return RouteRequirement|null Null if route not found in config
     */
    public function resolve(string $routeName): ?RouteRequirement
    {
        $routes = config('route_permissions.routes', []);

        if (!array_key_exists($routeName, $routes)) {
            return null; // Missing mapping is handled as a fail-closed error by the middleware.
        }

        $permissionString = $routes[$routeName];

        if ($permissionString === null) {
            return new RouteRequirement(RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE);
        }

        return $this->parse($permissionString);
    }

    /**
     * Parse a permission string into a RouteRequirement.
     *
     * Supports:
     *   - 'capability.string.scope' → TYPE_SINGLE
     *   - 'cap1 | cap2' → TYPE_ANY_OF
     *   - 'cap1 & cap2' → TYPE_ALL_OF (each part may contain | for OR)
     *   - 'system_admin_access' → TYPE_SPECIAL (if in specialPermissions map)
     */
    public function parse(string $permissionString): RouteRequirement
    {
        $permissionString = trim($permissionString);

        if ($permissionString === '__public__') {
            return new RouteRequirement(RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC);
        }

        // Check if it's a special permission
        if (isset($this->specialPermissions[$permissionString])) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL,
                specialMethod: $this->specialPermissions[$permissionString],
            );
        }

        // Split by '&' for AND clauses
        $andClauses = array_map('trim', explode('&', $permissionString));
        $andClauses = array_filter($andClauses, fn(string $c) => $c !== '');

        if (count($andClauses) === 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.');
        }

        if (count($andClauses) === 1) {
            // Single clause — might contain | for OR
            return $this->parseClause($andClauses[0]);
        }

        // Multiple AND clauses — each is a sub-requirement
        $subRequirements = array_map(fn(string $clause) => $this->parseClause($clause), $andClauses);

        return new RouteRequirement(
            type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF,
            clauses: $subRequirements,
        );
    }

    private function parseClause(string $clause): RouteRequirement
    {
        $clause = trim($clause);

        // Check if this clause is a special permission
        if (isset($this->specialPermissions[$clause])) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL,
                specialMethod: $this->specialPermissions[$clause],
            );
        }

        // Check for OR (|)
        $orParts = array_map('trim', explode('|', $clause));
        $orParts = array_filter($orParts, fn(string $p) => $p !== '');

        if (count($orParts) === 0) {
            throw new InvalidArgumentException('Route permission expression must contain at least one capability.');
        }

        if (count($orParts) === 1) {
            return new RouteRequirement(
                type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE,
                capabilities: [$orParts[0]],
            );
        }

        return new RouteRequirement(
            type: RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF,
            capabilities: $orParts,
        );
    }

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\SuspensionAuthorityMissing;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Single source of truth for events.* capability-authorization guards.
 *
 * Design mirrors BillingAuthorizationService:
 *   - No constructor injection (no collaborators needed — only Gate + actor).
 *   - Named void guards — throw on deny, return void on allow.
 *   - Preserve exact exception types per guard (the controller maps each to its
 *     own HTTP error envelope, so the type must not change):
 *       • moderation guards → SuspensionAuthorityMissing (HTTP 403)
 *       • all others        → Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException
 *
 * Capability strings are the shared contract between this service and EventPolicy /
 * route_permissions.php — keep them identical.
 *
 * Authorization ordering rule: all guards in this class are designed to be called
 * BEFORE any DB::transaction / lockForUpdate so that capability checks never execute
 * inside a lock. Callers must preserve this call ordering.
 */
class EventAuthorizationService
{
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Team-boundary helper
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert that $actor's current team matches $targetTeamId.
     *
     * This implements the team-boundary check described in the architecture:
     * the capability registrar rejects argument-bound gate checks, so we
     * enforce the cross-team boundary explicitly before delegating to the
     * team-scoped capability.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    private function assertCurrentTeamBoundary(User $actor, int $targetTeamId, string $message): void
    {
        $callerTeamId = $actor->currentTeam?->getKey();

        if ($callerTeamId === null || $callerTeamId !== $targetTeamId) {
            throw new AuthorizationException($message);
        }
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // View / read guards
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may view the given event.
     *
     * global bypass: events.view.global
     * team cap:      events.view.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeView(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.view.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team event view requires events.view.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.view.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // viewAny guard (for list surfaces)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may list events in the given team.
     *
     * Accepts Team (not Event) because list authorization is team-scoped,
     * not per-event. Preserves the current EventPolicy::viewAny behavior:
     * resolve through events.view.* capability.
     *
     * global bypass: events.view.global
     * team cap:      events.view.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeViewAny(Team $team, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.view.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $team->getKey(),
            'Cross-team event listing requires events.view.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.view.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Create guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may create events in the given team.
     *
     * Accepts Team (not Event) because no event exists yet at creation time.
     *
     * global bypass: events.create.global
     * team cap:      events.create.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeCreate(Team $team, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.create.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $team->getKey(),
            'Cross-team event creation requires events.create.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.create.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Update guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may update (metadata) events in the given team.
     *
     * Accepts Team (not Event) because callers already resolve the team from
     * the event and pass it directly (EventMetadataService, EventLandingService).
     *
     * global bypass: events.update.global
     * team cap:      events.update.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeUpdate(Team $team, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $team->getKey(),
            'Cross-team event update requires events.update.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.update.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Transition guards
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may drive a state transition on the given event.
     *
     * This general-purpose transition guard deliberately does NOT admit
     * events.force_end.global. Force-end has a dedicated transition guard below
     * so that emergency termination authority cannot become generic state
     * transition authority for public service callers.
     *
     * global bypass: events.update.global
     * team cap:      events.update.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeTransition(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team event transition requires events.update.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.update.team');
    }

    /**
     * Assert actor may drive the state-machine transition that backs force-end.
     *
     * This is intentionally narrower than authorizeTransition(): it only exists
     * for the force-end wrapper after authorizeForceEnd() has already passed,
     * and it only admits an ENDED target.
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeForceEndTransition(Event $event, EventState $next, User $actor): void
    {
        if ($next !== EventState::ENDED) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }

        $this->authorizeForceEnd($event, $actor);
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Publish guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may publish the given event (capability check only).
     *
     * The entitlement/plan-gate re-check (EVENT_PUBLISH) is NOT here — it
     * stays in EventLifecycleService::publish() immediately after this call.
     *
     * global bypass: events.publish.global
     * team cap:      events.publish.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizePublish(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.publish.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team publish requires events.publish.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.publish.team');
    }

    public function canPublish(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        $gate = Gate::forUser($actor);

        if ($gate->allows('events.publish.global')) {
            return true;
        }

        return $actor->currentTeam?->getKey() === $event->team_id
            && $gate->allows('events.publish.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cancel guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may cancel the given event.
     *
     * global bypass: events.cancel.global
     * team cap:      events.cancel.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeCancel(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.cancel.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team cancel requires events.cancel.global.'
        );

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.cancel.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Speaker write guard
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may perform speaker writes (add/update/reorder/delete) on the event.
     *
     * Authorization pattern mirrors authorizeTransition but without the
     * force_end.global bypass — speaker writes need only update authority.
     *
     * global bypass: events.update.global
     * team cap:      events.update.team
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeSpeakerWrite(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.global')) {
            return;
        }

        $this->assertCurrentTeamBoundary(
            $actor,
            $event->team_id,
            'Cross-team speaker mutation requires events.update.global.'
        );

        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.update.team')) {
            return;
        }

        Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('events.update.team');
    }

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Moderation guards (different shape — global-only, SuspensionAuthorityMissing)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Assert actor may suspend or reactivate the given event.
     *
     * Moderation guards are global-only: there is no team-scoped path.
     * The missing-cap exception is SuspensionAuthorityMissing (JKM-EVT-1004),
     * not AuthorizationException, to preserve distinct HTTP error envelopes.
     *
     * required cap: events.suspend.global
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeSuspend(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $this->canSuspend($event, $actor)) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }
    }

    public function canSuspend(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global');
    }

    /**
     * Assert actor may reactivate (unsuspend) the given event.
     *
     * Uses the same capability and exception as authorizeSuspend — the same
     * global role grants both suspend and reactivate authority.
     *
     * required cap: events.suspend.global
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeReactivate(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $this->canReactivate($event, $actor)) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }
    }

    public function canReactivate(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        return $this->canSuspend($event, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Assert actor may force-end the given event.
     *
     * Distinct from suspend — force_end.global is a separate two-cap.
     * Uses SuspensionAuthorityMissing for consistency with the other
     * moderation guards (same HTTP 403 / JKM-EVT-1004 envelope).
     *
     * required cap: events.force_end.global
     *
     * @throws SuspensionAuthorityMissing
     */
    public function authorizeForceEnd(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        if (! $this->canForceEnd($event, $actor)) {
            throw SuspensionAuthorityMissing::for($actor, $event);
        }
    }

    public function canForceEnd(Event $event, User $actor): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global');
    }

    /**
     * Register capability-based authorization with Laravel's Gate.
     *
     * Hooks into Gate::before to intercept capability checks and delegate
     * to the CapabilityChecker for actual permission evaluation.
     *
     * CRITICAL: Returns null for non-capability strings to preserve existing
     * policy behavior. Only handles 3-dot-separated capability strings.
     *

    public function register(): void
    {
        Gate::before(function ($user, string $ability, array $arguments = []) {
            if ($user === null || !$this->isCapabilityString($ability)) {
                return null;

                    'Capability gates do not accept resource arguments. Use a policy ability for resource-aware authorization.'

            return $this->resolveCapabilityChecker()->hasCapability($user, $ability);
        });

    {

        }

        return $this->capabilityChecker;
    }

    {
        if ($ability === '' || preg_match('/\s/', $ability)) {
            return false;
        }

        $segments = explode('.', $ability);

        if (count($segments) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '') {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

class RoleActionController
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly SuperAdminRoleService $service,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Show the permission-matrix editor for a role.
     *
     * SYSTEM_ADMIN is rendered read-only (no form).
     * Non-system roles render an editable permission-matrix form.
     */
    public function show(string $roleUuid): View
    {
        $role = $this->service->findByUuidOrFail($roleUuid);

        // Eager-load the permission count so the view uses $role->permissions_count
        // (avoiding an N+1 per-render query).
        $role->loadCount('permissions');

        // Group available permissions by resource for the matrix view.
        // AC2 scope filter: SYSTEM_ADMIN (is_system_admin=true) sees global-only permissions;
        // all other roles see non-global (team-scoped) permissions only.
        // Keyed on is_system_admin per Dev Notes flag-precision rule.
        $allPermissions = PermissionRegistry::allWithSystem();
        $permissionsByResource = [];
        foreach ($allPermissions as $permission) {
            $isGlobal = PermissionRegistry::isGlobalPermission($permission);
            // Skip permissions whose scope does not match this role type.
            if ($role->is_system_admin && ! $isGlobal) {
                continue;
            }
            if (! $role->is_system_admin && $isGlobal) {
                continue;
            }
            [$resource] = PermissionRegistry::parsePermission($permission);
            if ($resource !== null) {
                $permissionsByResource[$resource][] = $permission;
            }
        }
        ksort($permissionsByResource);

        return view('super-admin::roles.show', compact('role', 'permissionsByResource'));
    }

     * Update the permissions for a non-system role.
     *
     * POST /admin/roles/{roleUuid}/permissions

    public function updatePermissions(Request $request, string $roleUuid): RedirectResponse
    {
        $role = $this->service->findByUuidOrFail($roleUuid);

        // Controller-layer protected-role fence (defence-in-depth; service also checks).
        abort_unless(! $role->is_system_role, 403);

/**
 * Default CapabilityCheckerInterface implementation backed by PermissionEvaluator.
 *
 * This replaces the host app's PermissionEvaluatorAdapter. The package now
 * ships its own bridge between CapabilityCheckerInterface and PermissionEvaluator.
 */
class PermissionCapabilityChecker implements CapabilityCheckerInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly PermissionEvaluator $evaluator,
    ) {}

    public function hasCapability(Authenticatable $user, string $capability): bool
    {
        if (!$user instanceof PermissionSubjectInterface) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->evaluator->hasPermission($user, $capability);
    }
}

    {
        if (!$user instanceof PermissionSubjectInterface) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->evaluator->hasPermission($user, $capability);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Services;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Contracts\Repositories\SuperAdminEventRepositoryInterface;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Capsule T4 — platform-admin export of a single event's registration list.
 *
 * Support staff pull this list when investigating a delivery complaint, so the
 * rows carry attendee personal data. Two consequences shape this service:
 *
 *   1. Authorization is explicit and narrow. The capability checked here is the
 *      same `events.view.global` mapped to `admin.events.registrations.export`
 *      in config/route_permissions.php — reaching the admin area is not enough.
 *      The re-check is deliberate defence in depth: the route middleware is the
 *      first gate, this guard is the one that travels with the data.
 *   2. The query is bound to the requested event only, never to whatever the
 *      actor's TeamScope bypass would otherwise expose.
 */
class SuperAdminEventRegistrationExportService
{
    /**
     * The single capability that unlocks attendee personal data platform-wide.
     * Keep identical to the `admin.events.registrations.export` entry in
     * config/route_permissions.php.
     */
    public const CAPABILITY = 'events.view.global';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly SuperAdminEventRepositoryInterface $events,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function response(Event $event, User $actor): StreamedResponse
    {
        $this->authorize($actor);

        $rows = $this->rows($event);

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($rows): void {
            $handle = fopen('php://output', 'wb');
            if ($handle === false) {
                return;
            }

            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                fputcsv($handle, $row, escape: '\\');
            }

            fclose($handle);
        }, $this->filename($event), [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    private function authorize(User $actor): void
    {
        if (! Gate::forUser($actor)->allows(self::CAPABILITY)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException(
                'Exporting an event registration list requires '.self::CAPABILITY.'.'
            );
        }
    }

    /**
     * Header row plus one row per registration of this event.
     *
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function rows(Event $event): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers()];
